notes.title: Release Postponed!
notes.content:
We're overwhelmed by the massive anticipation for our little game, so we just wanted to let everyone know what's happening! 

We kind of spaced on the fact that we set today as the release date, and discovered — too late — that our debug cheats are still in the game.

I'm currently at my parent's house, away from the PC that we use to make builds, so I can't make a new build until after Easter. As soon as I get home I'll make a new build and we'll press the "[b]LAUNCH[/b]" button right away!

--
Friedemann & Thomas
